value.name: town laments Dicky's latest loss
value.description: A man on the street says Dicky lost again and the town's fighters have seen better days.
evidence: "Yeah, well, he lost again, ya know, so maybe he's gonna be Dicky all ovah again, no championships for Lowell, he's like the rest of us I guess. The town's seen bettah days, so have our fightahs."

value.name: Alice pressures Lou for a fair fight
value.description: Alice angrily calls Lou and demands a fair fight after Micky was nearly killed in the last one.
evidence: ALICE argues into the phone, 'Bullshit, Lou, I'm not gonna stop callin' til ya make it right and give us a fight that's fair! My boy coulda got killed last time. Like what? What else? OK, what is it? Mm, mm. Now you're talkin', that sounds very interesting, I'll get back to you.'

value.name: Alice secures a new opportunity
value.description: After negotiating on the phone, Alice tells the family they have a great opportunity and need to find Micky.
evidence: 'We gotta a great opportunity, we gotta find Micky.'

value.name: family reports Micky missing
value.description: Pork says nobody has seen Micky for about a week, alarming Alice.
evidence: PORK pipes up, 'Nobody seen him for like a week.'
ALICE groans, 'Jesus, it used to be Dicky was the one we couldn't find, now it's both of 'em?'

value.name: sisters speculate about Micky's girlfriend
value.description: The sisters suggest Micky is with a girl from the bar, and gossip escalates into rumors about her sexuality.
evidence: TAR (CINDY) suggests, 'I think Micky's with that girl from the bah.'
RED DOG (GAIL) adds, 'George was all fuckin' eagah for them to get togethah.'
BEAVER (PHYLLIS) whispers, 'I heard she's into threeways.'
PORK (CATHY) confirms, 'Yeah like one of them
